title: Crispi Zucchini in Basil Bean Cream
description: Thin zucchini half-moons bake in a creamy cannellini and basil sauce until just tender.
equipment: Vitamix or immersion blender and tall jug

steps.title: Blend the bean cream
steps.text: Blend {beans}, {broth}, {basil}, {oil} and {garlic} for 45 seconds until smooth enough to pour slowly.

steps.title: Coat the zucchini
steps.text: Fold {zucchini} into the bean cream in the room-temperature 6-cup Crispi glass container, leaving the crisper plate out. Press the slices down so each carries sauce.

steps.title: Bake in the sauce
steps.text: Attach the Crispi PowerPod directly to the container with the storage lid removed. Use Bake for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Turn the slices
steps.text: Fold the outer slices toward the middle so the cooler slices are exposed to the heat.

steps.title: Finish the bake
steps.text: Continue on Bake for 3–7 minutes until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the zucchini yields to a fork with slight resistance.

steps.title: Spoon onto plates
steps.text: Let stand for 2 minutes and spoon the zucchini with its bean cream onto two plates.

notes: Make ahead: Blend the bean cream up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled. Slice the zucchini just before baking. Refrigerate in shallow portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. The zucchini releases water after freezing and loses its bite. Fridge reheat: Reheat a portion gently in a covered skillet with a splash of water for 4–6 minutes, folding once, until it reaches 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight, then follow the fridge reheat instructions. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 102 kcal, 5.8 g protein, 14.6 g total carbohydrate, 2.8 g fat, 3.9 g fiber, 15 mg sodium.

methods.label: Samsung conventional oven
equipment: Vitamix or immersion blender and tall jug

steps.title: Allow for oven timing
steps.text: Use the first time given as a check. A covered metal dish may need 3–10 minutes longer; check tenderness or the center temperature every 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat Samsung Bake to 350°F and select a small shallow metal dish.

steps.title: Blend the bean cream
steps.text: Blend {beans}, {broth}, {basil}, {oil} and {garlic} for 45 seconds until smooth enough to pour slowly.

steps.title: Coat the zucchini
steps.text: Fold {zucchini} into the bean cream in the metal baking dish. Press the slices down so each carries sauce.

steps.title: Bake in the sauce
steps.text: Cover the dish and bake at 350°F Cover the dish and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Turn the slices
steps.text: Fold the outer slices toward the middle so the cooler slices are exposed to the heat.

steps.title: Finish the bake
steps.text: Cover the dish and bake at 350°F for 3–7 minutes until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the zucchini yields to a fork with slight resistance.

steps.title: Spoon onto plates
steps.text: Let stand for 2 minutes and spoon the zucchini with its bean cream onto two plates.
